title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

title: Little Nikita
description: An FBI agent (Sidney Poitier) finds a dormant link between an Air Force Academy applicant's (River Phoenix) parents and the KGB.

title: Crooked House
description: Someone poisons the patriarch of the wealthy Leonides family, leading to an investigation.

title: Mary Reilly
description: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (John Malkovich) confides in a young chambermaid (Julia Roberts) and transforms into evil Mr. Hyde in 19th-century London.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: Hardwired
description: A man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) turns to hackers for help after he awakes from a car accident and learns he has a computer chip implanted in his brain.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: Legion
description: A battle for the future of mankind unfolds when the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany) arrives at a roadside diner to protect a waitress whose unborn child is humanity's last hope.

title: Anaconda
description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: The Princess and the Marine
description: A Marine has a forbidden romance with a Muslim Bahraini princess and sneaks her to the United States to marry her.

title: Wings of Courage
description: A pilot (Craig Sheffer) crashes during a terrible storm, walks away, and gets lost in the Andes Mountains.

title: Birdy
description: A Vietnam veteran helps his bird-obsessed boyhood buddy in a psychiatric hospital.

title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
description: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.

title: The Beast
description: Afghan villagers use a found weapon to hunt a Soviet commander's (George Dzundza) tank trapped in a valley.

title: Company of Heroes
description: During World War II, a group of American soldiers heads to the heart of Nazi Germany to find a scientist who developed a devastating weapon for Hitler and now wants to defect.

title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: 28 Days
description: When a court order sends a New York journalist (Sandra Bullock) to a rehabilitation center for substance abusers, she meets a ballplayer.

title: Random Hearts
description: A cop (Harrison Ford) and a politician (Kristin Scott Thomas) seek the truth about their spouses, killed together in a plane crash on the way to the same address.

title: The River Murders
description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Quicksilver
description: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city.

title: Finding Graceland
description: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.

title: Nothing in Common
description: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.

title: First Daughter
description: A female Secret Service agent (Mariel Hemingway) and a river guide (Doug Savant) must rescue the president's kidnapped daughter (Monica Keena).

title: First Target
description: A Secret Service agent trains long and hard to protect the president, only to realize too late that the opening of new mountain transport in Seattle is just a ploy to ambush him.

title: First Shot
description: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

title: Awakenings
description: A doctor (Robin Williams) tries the drug L-dopa on an immobile man (Robert De Niro) and others like him in 1969 New York.

title: The Tourist
description: During an impromptu trip to Europe, a man's (Johnny Depp) flirtation with an alluring stranger (Angelina Jolie) leads to a dangerous game of cat and mouse.

title: Takers
description: A determined detective (Matt Dillon) and Russian mobsters complicate the plan of a gang of skilled thieves to rob an armored car carrying millions of dollars.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: The Master of Disguise
description: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

title: Apple of My Eye
description: A tragic accident causes a young equestrian (Avery Arendes) to lose her sight and her ability to connect with anyone or anything, until a miniature horse named Apple is trained to be her companion and surrogate eyes.

title: Ice Castles
description: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Home Invasion
description: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive.
